name: Majid Alyousef
bio: Majid Alyousef is a renowned calligrapher and designer known for his mastery of the Thuluth script and his innovative contemporary compositions.
proof_notes: Verified via official website and public exhibitions in Dubai.

name: Wissam Shawkat
bio: Wissam Shawkat is a world-class calligrapher and designer who has developed a unique style known as Calligraformy, blending traditional forms with modern abstraction.
proof_notes: Verified via official website and his gallery in Alserkal Avenue, Dubai.

name: Mattar Bin Lahej
bio: Mattar Bin Lahej is a self-taught Emirati artist, photographer, and sculptor, famous for his 'Mattar Script' and large-scale calligraphy sculptures.
proof_notes: Verified via official website and Mattar Gallery in Dubai.

name: eL Seed
bio: eL Seed uses complex Arabic calligraphy to spread messages of peace and unity, blending graffiti with traditional calligraphy in a style he calls 'calligraffiti'.
proof_notes: Verified via official website and his studio in Dubai.

name: Narjes Noureddine
bio: Narjes Noureddine is an award-winning calligrapher who specializes in classical scripts, bringing a refined and traditional aesthetic to her work.
proof_notes: Verified via official website and participation in UAE calligraphy festivals.

name: Nihad Taisir Nadam
bio: Nihad Taisir Nadam is a digital artist and designer focusing on the intersection of Arabic calligraphy and modern technology.
proof_notes: Verified via official website and professional profile.
